data.object: W_A(q)=[A]_q!=prod_{k=1}^A [k]_q = sum_{w in S_A} q^{len(w)} (coinvariant Poincaré / jet-filtration graded dim); NON-determinant (no -ln det)
data.verdict: SCOPE-(a) HONEST NEGATIVE on the crack, STRUCTURAL ADVANCE on the escape. The jet-filtration graded dimension W_A(q)=[A]_q!=Σ_{w∈S_A}q^{ℓ(w)} (=Σ_λ dim(λ)f^λ(q), coinvariant Poincaré / graded dim of the principal filtration on H_A) is a NON-determinant object — a sum of positive q-powers, not −ln det — so it is outside the three Lean-excluded exchange-determinant no-gos. It ESCAPES the C(A,2) cap, q-INDEPENDENTLY: the classical ratio A!/2!={3,12} already has 12 > 6=C(4,2), and at q₀ ρ_grad(4)=15.74 > 13.03 ⇒ it is the FIRST non-determinant object that can REACH ρ_4=13.03 (the determinant provably cannot). It does NOT land both parameter-free: at q₀ ρ_grad(3)=3.34 (−12%) and ρ_grad(4)=15.74 (+21%); it undershoots A=3 and overshoots A=4. The A=3→A=4 step [4]_q ≥ 4 for all q≥1 is too steep vs the data ratio 3.42, and ρ_strong(3)=3.81 exceeds even the classical 3!/2!=3, so no single parameter-free q lands both. BRACKET: sub-extensive log-det (undershoots both, capped) < true binding < super-extensive graded dim (overshoots A=4). NOT excluded as an ingredient (permanence): a graded-dim factor may combine with a growth-DAMPING term; this probe measures the direction of the missing correction. No fit; nothing wired.

caveats: Scope-(a): the graded dimension ALONE does not close the magnitude; it is not excluded as an ingredient (permanence).
The ESCAPE (graded dim > C(A,2) cap) is proved q-independently (A!/2!=12>6) — a structural advance, not a numerical near-match.
No fit: q₀ fixed from substrate BEFORE comparison; the q_forcing_rho3 solve is shown ONLY to demonstrate no single q lands both — it is NOT wired.
